The Fibonacci Retracement is a technical analysis tool that identifies potential support and resistance levels. The Bollinger Bands are a volatility indicator that shows the range of prices over a specified period of time. The Relative Strength Index (RSI) is a momentum indicator that shows the strength of a trend.
